caption: The drawing depicts a square swatch of fabric with a checked pattern consisting of alternating light beige, medium tan, and dark brown squares arranged in a grid of three rows by three columns. The fabric appears woven, with the texture and direction of the threads visible in diagonal and horizontal patterns within each square, created through the use of fine, detailed lines. The light beige squares are concentrated in the top right, center, and bottom left positions, while the dark brown squares appear in the top center, middle left, and bottom center positions. The remaining squares are a medium tan color. The background is a plain, off-white or cream-toned paper, and the fabric swatch is centrally placed with faint guideline marks visible at the edges.
title: Shaker Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
